episode_summary: The team discuss Bertha von Suttner—briefly Alfred Nobel’s housekeeper—becoming the first female Nobel Peace laureate, then dive into the near-extinction and recovery of the sunflower sea star. They explore 1980s physical keys for computer security and password/AI hacking oddities, and finish with the go-away-bird and the wild world of bird calls and names.
